# The llcommon integration tests ThreadSanitizer does not run: the deny list. Every other test of the library runs.
# Boost.Fiber is prebuilt without TSan fibre annotations, so a test that switches fibres (coroutines) would report
# races that are not there; the tests that start child processes are left out for the same reason (TSan and fork).
# A name here that is no test of the library is a warning in the plan job's summary.
lleventcoro
llcond
workqueue
llleap
llprocess
llprocessstdin
llsdserialize
